LanguageData.VRF_HoverTakeoffDesc: The vehicle takes off and gains altitude.
LanguageData.VRF_HoverFaceTargetDesc: The vehicle will always face the selected target.
LanguageData.VRF_HoverAttackTargetDesc: The vehicle will command all its manned or automatic turrets to fire at the target when in range, while automatically adjusting its facing.
LanguageData.VRF_HoverCancelTargetDesc: Cancels the automatic tracking and the attack order on the current target.
LanguageData.VRF_HoverEngineOff: The engine must be turned on to takeoff.
LanguageData.VRF_HoverAirplaneLandDesc: Select a landing zone. The aircraft needs a clear runway in the approach direction.
LanguageData.VRF_HoverCannotTurnOffEngine: Cannot turn off the engine while the vehicle is airborne.
LanguageData.VRF_HoverJumpDesc: Order a pawn to jump from the vehicle with a parachute.
LanguageData.VRF_HoverNoPilot: No pilot aboard. The vehicle will crash.
LanguageData.VRF_HoverLandingFailed: {0} could not find a landing path. Landing aborted.
